problems.problem: Prose: 'the present hundred years cannot be told from a dream' carries Guo Xiang's 今之百年 without its point. His image is the napper who dreams through a hundred years (世有假寐，而夢經百年者), and with the nap dropped the phrase reads as opaque at six in the morning. 'Cannot be told from' also slightly overstates 無以明…非假寐之夢, which says only that it cannot be shown not to be one.
problems.fix: Keep the plain sense and change the reading to: 'Guo Xiang, on chapter 2, reads it as each state suiting its moment, so a hundred-year life may be one long nap’s dream, and grieving at death while alive is an error.' That is 44 words, and every clause comes from the evidence already verified.

problems.problem: Prose and exactness: 'darkly one' is an obscure rendering of 相冥. 'the text as lodging that roaming in these friends' also drops Guo Xiang's reason, which is the point of the note: the text gives the beyond-the-bounds to these men because it would be refused if said outright of Confucius (若直就稱仲尼之如此，或者將據所見以排之). Without that reason a reader cannot see why the lodging matters, since the key verse has Confucius say he travels within.
problems.fix: Change the reading to: 'Guo Xiang, on chapter 6, reads outside and inside as one, the sage roaming outside to enlarge the inside, a roaming the text gives these friends lest readers refuse it in Confucius.' That is 44 words in all, supported by 夫理有至極，外內相冥 / 故聖人常遊外以弘內 / 若直就稱仲尼之如此，或者將據所見以排之，故…寄方外於數子.

problems.problem: The plain sense is ambiguous. In 'The chapter denies that the retired scholars of old hid, blaming the times' the dangling 'blaming the times' reads as if the scholars were blaming the times. Giles 16.27 has the chapter itself say that the age was unsuited to their mission.
problems.fix: Rewrite the plain sense as: 'The chapter says the retired scholars of old did not hide but met an age unsuited to their mission;'. Leave the reading unchanged, then rerun entry-check to confirm the four-word overlap rule and a total of 45 words or fewer.

problems.problem: The batch names the place inconsistently. Days 1 to 18 say 'Guo Xiang, on chapter N', but days 19 to 22 (zhuangzi-01-d019-p, d020-p, d021-p, d022-p) say 'on 14.132', 'on 16.27', 'on 17.10' and 'on 17.149'. Those are Giles’ app section numbers, not places in Guo Xiang’s commentary, which has no such numbering (the plan trap says to locate by opening words, not paragraph number). The src lines for the same four days add 'on N.NNN' as well.
problems.fix: Use the batch's form on days 19 to 22 in both the sentence and the src: 'Guo Xiang, on chapter 14,' / 'on chapter 16,' / 'on chapter 17,'. Every one of these edits shortens its sentence.
